spec_match.rationale: Builds DisplayMediaStreamOptions member-by-member with the correct sibling enums (systemAudio include/exclude, windowAudio window/system/exclude, monitorTypeSurfaces include/exclude) and correctly explains why a dictionary member cannot be feature-detected.

interactive.rationale: Selects and the audio checkbox rebuild the JSON live (initial render verified showing video/audio/audioSelection), and the run button executes the exact assembled getDisplayMedia() call with the result read back.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The blurb promises member-by-member assembly, the exact JSON, a real run, and the honest-degradation explanation — all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Omit-vs-include per member, rejection reporting, picker-pending lockout, pagehide race cleanup, and track stopping are all covered.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5085785343787008 (verified) and the DisplayMediaStreamOptions spec anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite passed 8/8 in this browser with meaningful negative assertions matching this page's non-detectability teaching.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI: probe shows 'callable', the JSON preview renders the default object, console clean (fonts.googleapis.com failure environmental); the picker flow needs a gesture and could not be driven here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts record resolved vs fallback runs including whether audioSelection was sent, on top of injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables, correct button overrides, and a narrow-viewport padding query are all present, but the emerald 'callable' probe text on stone (~3.7:1) is below AA for its small size.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects with aria-describedby hints, an aria-live JSON preview, and a role=status result line make the build-and-run loop keyboard- and screen-reader-usable.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness-validated ok/ok recorded in responsive-support.json (2026-07-24); the single-column field stack and wrap-anywhere code chips fit narrow viewports; this session's own 360px CLI capture is inconclusive due to the headless min-width clamp.

openQuestions.title: Raise the emerald probe text to AA
openQuestions.detail: The .ok emerald (#0a8f5c) on bg-stone measures ~3.7:1 at 0.78rem, under the 4.5:1 normal-text bar. Shared with the sibling pages — a slightly darker emerald for small text would fix all three at once.

summary: The strongest page in this feature trio: accurate member-by-member options assembly with the correct enum vocabularies, a real run of the exact object, honest non-detectability teaching that matches the conformance suite's negative assertions, live-region output, and per-run telemetry. Only a minor AA contrast miss on the small emerald probe text. Verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshots, DOM, clean console); the picker flow cannot be driven headlessly so runtime evidence is partial. Mobile parity relies on the harness-recorded ok/ok from 2026-07-24.
